_note: Starting values from DLMM-Auto-Entry-Spec v1 (133 closed positions, Oct 25 - Nov 4 2026). Change only after re-testing on unseen tokens (spec section 7).

gates._maxPositionPctOfTvl: off (owner, 2026-11-04); set a number like 3 to gate size vs TVL again

position._ladder: RH ladder: equal-width slices from the price down to rangeBottomPct, SOL split 1:2:...:n (deepest slice biggest), Spot inside each

signal._note: Entry ping: pool passes the v1 gates AND sits inside the benchmark wallet's habitat (bin steps it made SOL in + p10-p90 of pool age, mcap, fees 1h/24h at its entries). A similarity check on top of the gates, not a predictor (spec section 2).
signal._mode: blast = one card with the top blastTop pools every blastEveryMin; new = one ping per pool when it newly matches (cooldownHours)
signal._blastSortBy: volTvl1h (1h Vol/TVL) | feeTvl24h (1d Fees/TVL) | fees1hUsd | prorated5m

revival._note: Dead-then-alive pools (pump-and-dump on a quiet token, e.g. DAVID-SOL): >= minDeadHours hours in a row with fees < deadHourPct% of the 24h total AND the 3 busiest hours >= minTop3Share of 24h fees. Owner's call (2026-11-05): gate. Benchmark data: 4 such entries, all won (+1.42 SOL), so 'flag' keeps them with a warning, 'off' ignores it.

signal._matchDims: The filter = v1 gates + these bands (owner's GMGN filter, 2026-11-05: one layer, no benchmark layer). Available: tokenAgeHours, poolAgeHours, mcapUsd, volume24hUsd, totalFeesSol, fees24hUsd, fees1hUsd
signal._requireBenchmarkBinSteps: true = also require a bin step the benchmark wallet made SOL in (the old layer 2). The benchmark wallet still drives the 👀 wallet-entry pings.

bandOverrides._note: Owner's layer-2 bands, GMGN-style (2026-11-05): age 60m-15000m, mcap $400K-$10M, volume >= $50K, total fees >= 50 SOL. null = no limit. tokenAgeHours / volume24hUsd are token-wide (DexScreener, all pairs); totalFeesSol is this DLMM pool's LP fees since launch (GMGN's 'Total Fees' counts trader fees on every venue, no free source).

exits._note: Spec section 4: every fixed TP / SL / trailing / time limit lost SOL vs. holding (TP +1/+2/+5/+10% = -7.16/-7.57/-4.37/-1.06 SOL). They stay null unless you turn them on.
